title: Gradient Text Do’s and Don’ts
slide_intent: Use dimensional type selectively so a special offer gains emphasis without becoming harder to read.
strategic_value: Controlled gradient lettering can distinguish a high-profile T-Mobile product while retaining brand color.
demonstration: Approved magenta and white gradient text is compared with a purple treatment and a thin-weight treatment.
practical_value: Choose a substantial weight and an approved color before applying a gradient to a word or text block.

content_islands.name: Purpose and limits
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation of selective product emphasis at left.

content_islands.name: Approved gradient type
content_islands.spec: Stack magenta product text and a white multiline headline in the middle.

content_islands.name: Rejected gradient type
content_islands.spec: Place the alternate-color and thin-weight examples opposite their approved comparisons.

ingredient.name: Gradient lettering
ingredient.role: Add emphasis and dimensionality to a high-profile phrase.
ingredient.application: Use magenta or white gradients and avoid lighter weights; a gradient may span the full height of a multiline block.
ingredient.scope: Selective high-profile products or services, not routine treatment for every message.
